logp.method_description: The lipophilicity was determined using the shake flask method. Ir-FA, Ir-NH2, and Ir-FA were dissolved in PBS buffer at equal concentrations of 20 μM and pre-saturated with n-octanol. An equal volume of n-octanol solution saturated with PBS buffer was added to each compound. The mixture was shaken in the dark for 8 h at room temperature. The two phases were separated by centrifugation, and the absorbance of the compounds in the organic phase and the aqueous phase was measured using UV-vis spectroscopy. The log Po/w is defined as the logarithmic ratio of the concentration of the sample in the organic phase to the aqueous phase.
